application.css:
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Playfair+Display:wght@600;700&display=swap');
:root{--ink:#20242a;--muted:#5f6874;--cream:#f7f5f0;--paper:#fff;--line:#e7e5df;--blue:#4266d5;--blue-dark:#3152b9;--green:#287b59}*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);font-family:'DM Sans',Arial,sans-serif}.shell{max-width:1120px;margin:auto;padding:68px 28px 80px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.15fr;gap:72px}.intro{padding:18px 0}.brand-mark{width:45px;height:45px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--blue);color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:25px;margin-bottom:54px;box-shadow:0 9px 22px #4266d546}.eyebrow{text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:2px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--blue);margin:0 0 12px}.intro h1{font:700 clamp(42px,5vw,66px)/1.04 'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;margin:0 0 24px;letter-spacing:-1.5px}.intro h1 span{color:var(--blue)}.intro-copy{max-width:340px;color:var(--muted);font-size:16px;line-height:1.7}.intro-note{margin-top:54px;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px}.dot{width:8px;height:8px;background:#287b59;border-radius:50%}.panel{background:var(--paper);padding:38px 42px;border-radius:20px;box-shadow:0 16px 50px #373d5010}.panel-heading,.section-heading{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start}.panel h2,.bookings-section h2{font:700 27px 'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;margin:0}.calendar-icon{color:var(--blue);font-size:27px}.field{margin-top:22px}.field label{display:block;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:8px;color:#525a65}.field input,.field select{width:100%;height:47px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;background:#fcfcfb;padding:0 14px;font:14px 'DM Sans',Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);outline:none;transition:.2s}.field input:focus,.field select:focus{border-color:var(--blue);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #4266d51a}.form-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px}.primary-button{border:0;border-radius:8px;background:var(--blue);color:#fff;width:100%;height:50px;margin-top:20px;font:700 14px 'DM Sans',Arial,sans-serif;cursor:pointer}.primary-button:hover{background:var(--blue-dark)}.primary-button span{font-size:20px;margin-left:8px}.form-error{color:#b63d3d;font-size:12px;min-height:16px;margin:14px 0 0}.bookings-section{grid-column:1/-1}.section-heading{align-items:center;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding-bottom:19px}.count{background:#e4e9fb;color:var(--blue);font-weight:700;font-size:12px;border-radius:20px;padding:7px 12px}.booking-list{display:grid;gap:12px;margin-top:18px}.empty-state{text-align:center;padding:40px;color:var(--muted);border:1px dashed #d5d5cf;border-radius:12px}.empty-state span{font-size:28px;color:#586273}.empty-state p{margin:9px 0 3px;font-weight:700;color:#626a76}.empty-state small{font-size:12px}.confirmation{display:none;margin-top:18px;background:#e9f6ef;color:var(--green);padding:12px 16px;border-radius:8px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600}.confirmation.show{display:block}.booking-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:19px 20px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:15px}.booking-card.cancelled{opacity:.65}.booking-card.cancelled .booking-name{text-decoration:line-through}.booking-name{font-weight:700;margin:0 0 7px}.booking-meta{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin:0}.booking-type{font-size:12px;color:var(--blue);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:7px}.cancel-button{background:transparent;border:1px solid #e1bcbc;color:#ae5353;border-radius:7px;padding:8px 12px;font:600 12px 'DM Sans',Arial,sans-serif;cursor:pointer}.cancel-button:hover{background:#fff3f3}.status-label{font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1px;color:#ae5353;font-weight:700}@media(max-width:760px){.shell{display:block;padding:35px 18px 60px}.intro{padding:0 4px 38px}.brand-mark{margin-bottom:32px}.intro-note{margin-top:28px}.panel{padding:27px 21px}.bookings-section{margin-top:45px}.booking-card{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}.cancel-button{align-self:flex-end}.form-row{gap:10px}}
